hint.label: Usage Guide
hint.value:
## 💬 Facebook Messenger Setup & Token Guide

### Step 1: Get Page Access Token
1. Go to [Meta Graph API Explorer](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/).
2. Under **Meta App**, select your App.
3. Under **User or Page**, select **Get Page Access Token** and pick your Facebook Page.
4. Under **Permissions**, add `pages_messaging` and `pages_show_list`.
5. Click **Generate Access Token** and copy the token into the **Page Access Token** field below.

### Step 2: Set Meta Webhook Callback URL
1. Copy the Webhook URL from the top of this node (`https://core.aimicromind.com/webhook/{chatflowId}/messenger`).
2. In Meta Developer Portal ➔ **Messenger** ➔ **Webhooks** ➔ click **Add Callback URL**.
3. Paste the Webhook URL and enter your **Verify Token** (e.g. `my_messenger_token`).
4. Click **Verify and Save** ✅.
5. Subscribe to `messages` and `messaging_postbacks`.

### Step 3: Activate & Test Live
1. Toggle the workflow to **ACTIVE** in the canvas header!
2. Send a Facebook message to your page — AI will auto-reply in real-time!
